outcome: Fecal short chain fatty acids (SCFAs) levels
Serum microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA)-related factors (5-HT, GABA, BDNF, GR, CRH, IL-6, TNF-a)
cohort: Female rats used to establish a preterm cognitive impairment model.
finding: Alterations in intestinal microflora structure and the abundances of SCFAs contributed substantially to cognitive impairment in preterm rats, associated with significant changes in MGBA-related soluble factors.
